name.value: Jens Kristian Villadsen

description.value: Test plan for the **Resource Access Provider** actor of [EU Health Data API, 1.0.0-ballot](https://build.fhir.org/ig/euridice-org/eu-health-data-api/). The SUT serves individual FHIR resources for a patient, behind SMART Backend Services. Each `suite` below is a `Rule:` of the Gherkin feature named by `suite.input.file`, and each `suite.test` one of its `Scenario:` lines, matched by the scenario's identifier. The assertions are the scenario's `Then` steps, verbatim. The tests declare which specification obligations they cover (34 requirement paths named by the feature tags). Fixture prerequisites, input bindings and expected data are in tests/fixtures/provider-v1/manifest.json, keyed by scenario ID. See the Testing page, Fixture contract and expected results. Provider fixtures are R4; client workflows use the canned data embedded in their feature.
